transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to convene this work-based learning placement review. We have a draft plan placing a student at Eastside Community Center for 60 hours, with a general site mentor and transcript code WBL-LOCAL. I understand Northline Clinic has also offered a placement with a named supervisor, though it involves a longer commute. As a reminder, our review today is limited to site suitability, hours, transcript code, and supervisor qualifications — transportation logistics are handled outside this process. I'd like to hear from the work-based learning teacher and the graduation records specialist: please share your recommendation and any unresolved objections before I make my final decision.
